description: 1SS133 small-signal switching diode (our fit to ROHM's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.if_avg: ROHM 1SS133 data sheet, Absolute maximum ratings: mean rectifying current IO 130 mA
rating_sources.vr_max: ROHM 1SS133 data sheet, Absolute maximum ratings: DC reverse voltage VR 80 V

fit.figure: Fig.1 Forward characteristics, Ta = 25 °C, from 0.2 mA (read from the PDF's vector drawing)
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point, the curve's last point always included; IS held under the sheet's 0.5 µA reverse-current limit at 80 V; CJO is the sheet's 2 pF maximum at 0.5 V; BV 90 V, the peak reverse voltage
fit.note: The figure starts at 0.2 mA; below that the fit follows the diode equation
